GameShell already pads p-0 md:p-4, so the gutter was this component's own; it is now p-0 lg:p-4 and the board runs the frame's 375, 373 inside its hairline. WITH IT THE CARD SHARE HAD TO SPLIT, and that is the measurement this pass makes: 9873:792 draws the card 48.591 on a 373 box (13.0271%) while 9815:19455 draws 90.732 on a 952 box (9.531%). One clamp lands both only if the cap swallows the wide end, and 13.0271% caps only above a 696.5 box - the shipped 1440 board is 656 (the row spends 356 on the panel and 224 on the History rail), so a single share would draw 85.4 there against the frame's 90.732. The share is now an arbitrary custom property on the board, which is also the container-query container: clamp(26px,13.0271cqw,90.732px) below lg and clamp(26px,15.046cqw,90.732px) from lg, with the desktop value as the var's fallback so nothing outside the board moves. Both resolve to their own frame's card exactly, proven in baccaratBetCellRow.test.ts. The panel half 9873:584 375x316 is closed with 9825-21961 this pass. TWO DEPARTURES, both recorded rather than gaps: the title row is drawn at x=23.5 w=328 while the frame's other four blocks are at 16/343 - a 7.5 hand-placement difference in one row with no ruling, not reproduced, and it is drawn by RoutedGamePage from PLAY_PAGE_GUTTER_CLASS in modules/skai-gaming/src/components/play/shared/playPageTemplate.ts, outside this lane's owns and shared by every routed game (a HAND-OFF if the 23.5 is ever ruled the intent); and the board's 307 height is content plus padding rather than a pinned aspect, which is the standing call in the component - the two cuts do not share a board aspect and a pinned one overflows by 43 at a 352 board.

DESKTOP PAGE 1440x3294. Its one named remaining item was the board and the panel inside the 1318x621 game block. The PANEL is closed 2026-09-20 - the wave 53 strip ruling plus the two blocks built this pass give the 356 column the frame's 42 / 66 / 90 / 66 / 24 / 52 on a flat 16, closing at 436. The BOARD is measured for the first time and does not match. THE BOARD COLUMN IS NOT THE FRAME'S WIDTH AT EITHER CUT, measured from source this pass rather than assumed. The shell chain is RoutedGamePage (w-full px-4, max-w-[1318px]) then GameShell (p-0 md:p-4) then the game row (gap-2), and the row carries THREE columns, not two: the 356 panel, the board, and a 224 History rail that is in NEITHER frame and trails both by design. At 1440 that leaves the board column 1286 - 356 - 8 - 224 - 8 = 690, less its own p-4 and a 1px border, so the felt's container-query box is 656 where 9825:20952 draws 952. At 375 the row is 375, the column's p-4 takes 32 and the border 2, so the box is 341 where 9873:722 draws a full-bleed 375 (373 inside its hairline). The card still lands 90.732 at 1440 ONLY because CARD_UNIT is clamp(26px, 15.046cqw, 90.732px) and the cap absorbs the error - 656 x 15.046% is 98.8, over the cap - while at 375 nothing absorbs it and 341 x 15.046% draws 51.3 against the frame's 48.591, over by 2.71. One clamp cannot land both once the phone is full bleed: 48.591/373 is 13.0271cqw, which caps only above a 696.5 box and would draw 85.4 on the shipped 656. So the constant is not the defect - the board width is, and the 224 rail plus the column's 32 of padding is where it goes. NOT CHANGED: removing either is a layout ruling on an element the frames do not draw, and guessing it would restyle a surface nobody measured.
